name: Ask Matt
description: Ask which skill or flow fits your situation. A router over the skills in this repo.
longDescription: A user-invoked router over **24 sibling skills**. It lays out the **main flow** — `/grill-with-docs`, an optional `/prototype` detour bridged by `/handoff`, then `/to-spec`, `/to-tickets` and `/implement` (which drives `/tdd` and `/code-review`) — plus **3 on-ramps** (`/triage`, `/diagnosing-bugs`, `/wayfinder`), the vocabulary layer (`/domain-modeling`, `/codebase-design`) and standalone tools such as `/grill-me`, `/research` and `/wizard`. Also covers context hygiene and the five choices at a phase boundary (continue, `/clear`, `/handoff`, subagent, `/compact`). Assumes `/setup-matt-pocock-skills` ran once per repo.
